items.difficulty_reason: 18 行、层化泛性质：函子性给交换方框，问题归约为 G -> G# 为同构；由茎判据（points-exactness）化为茎上双射；再由层化不改茎收尾。承重三步（方框、茎判据、茎相等）都在 span 内；2 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-sheafify-universal (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1805-1811

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the functoriality of sheafification gives a commutative square, reducing to G = G#; by the exactness of stalk functors it suffices to check stalkwise bijectivity, which is the equality of stalks under sheafification (source lines 1813-1830)
